description: Compare 2 to 10 TACO foods (ids from search_food) on chosen nutrients, per 100 g of edible portion. Missing data stays null or {"trace":true}; do not rank a food with null as having less.

food_ids.description: TACO food numbers to compare, as returned by search_food.

nutrients.description: Nutrient keys to compare. Omit for energy, protein, fat, carbohydrate, fiber and sodium.

name: compare_foods

foods.description: The foods compared, in the order received.

name.description: Food name exactly as in the TACO table.

nutrients.description: One row per requested nutrient, in table order.

values.description: One value per food, in the same order as foods.

items.description: A number in the nutrient unit; {"trace":true} when the table reports a trace (Tr, below the quantification limit); null when the TACO table publishes no value (not analyzed, not applicable or under re-evaluation). Never read null or trace as 0.

title: Compare foods side by side
